decisions.reason: As a facial-care line very close to the firm's core knowledge and still given its own page after two years, it fits existing absorptive capacity well and likely provides enough learning and sales potential to retain.

The hyaluronic serum is also close to the established skincare base, and its continued presence suggests the firm can interpret results and improve it, though the lighter website prominence points to a somewhat higher pruning risk than A.

The cleansing oil is a recent adjacent extension that the firm is technically well placed to develop further, but because it is newer and has only limited market evidence so far, it carries the highest short-term discontinuation risk among the products still listed.
